fraud.text:
a)	During the course of our examination of the books and records of the Company, carried out in accordance with the generally accepted auditing practices in India, and according to the information and explanations given to us, we have neither come across any instance of material fraud by the Company or on the Company, noticed or reported during the year, nor have we been informed of any such case by the Management.
b)	No report under Section 143(12) of the Act, in Form ADT-4, as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 was required to be filed with the Central Government. Accordingly, the reporting under Clause 3(xi)(b) of the Order is not applicable to the Company.
c)	As represented to us by the management, there are no whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year.

statutory_dues.text:
vii.            In respect of statutory and other dues: 

a)      The Company does not have liability in respect of Service tax, Duty of excise, Sales tax and Value added tax during the year since effective 1 July 2017, these statutory dues has been subsumed into Goods and Service Tax (GST).

 

The Company has been generally regular in depositing amounts deducted / accrued in the books of account in respect of undisputed statutory dues, including Goods and Service Tax, Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance, Income Tax, Duty of Customs, Cess and other material statutory dues applicable to it with the appropriate authorities during the year. No undisputed amounts payable in respect of aforesaid dues were in arrears, as at 31 March 2026

business_summary.text: Powerica makes Cummins-powered diesel generator sets and medium-speed large generators with Hyundai, and runs an independent wind power business plus BoP EPC and O&M.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at double-digit, reiterated from earlier.
DG set margins to remain subdued in Q1 and part of Q2, improving from Q3 onward.
50 MW wind project to be commissioned in Q4FY27; 150 MW in FY28 and 100 MW the year after.
New wind projects expected at 82-83% EBITDA margin; old 330 MW at 62-63%; EPC at 10-11%.
Commodity price inflation and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on margins; price hikes taken in two phases.
Tax rate guided at 25.168% for the year, normalising after last year's one-time deferred tax reversal.
MSLG won a ₹41 Cr tender to be executed over 12-15 months; pipeline strong with PSU second phase.
Management is targeting double-digit top line growth in FY27.
The company repaid ₹525 Cr of existing debt in Q1 FY27 using IPO proceeds.
Data centers contributed 12% of total revenue in FY26 with robust ongoing order visibility.
9MFY26 EBITDA margin 13.6% and PAT margin 10.5%; Q3 margin 10.4%.
DG sets were 81.8% and wind 18.2% of 9MFY26 revenue; mix drives overall margin.
BoP EPC: 450.40 MW developed, 435.60 MW under construction, LOA for 150 MW.

operating_notes.text: Generator Set segment EBITDA margin was 9.3% in 9MFY26 vs 8.6% in 9MFY25; Wind Power segment margin was 33.1% vs 42.7%.
DG sets powered by Cummins engines contributed 63.7% of 9MFY26 revenue (70.0% a year earlier); MSLG with Hyundai 5.5% (2.0%).
Operational wind portfolio of 12 projects under 25-year fixed-tariff PPAs with GUVNL and SECI; EPC for BoP covers 12 projects totalling 450.40 MW.
9MFY26 DG set segment EBITDA margin 9.3% vs 8.6% a year earlier; wind segment margin 33.1% vs 42.7%.
Wind IPP: 330.85 MW operating under 25-year PPAs, tariff range ₹2.4–4.19/kWh; 50 MW under construction at ₹3.81/kWh.
BoP EPC: 450.40 MW developed, 435.60 MW under construction, LOA for 150 MW; also a 7.2 km 400 kV line and 220/400 kV substation.
FY26 segment EBITDA margins: Generator Set 9.1% (FY25 8.4%), Wind Power 31.3% (FY25 41.4%).
FY26 revenue mix: Cummins-powered DG sets 65.5%, MSLG with Hyundai 5.1%, allied business 12.5%, wind IPP 6.7%, BoP EPC and O&M 10.1%.
O&M services for BoP at 10 wind projects totalling 296.50 MW; EPC for BoP covers 12 projects totalling 450.40 MW.
Data centers contributed 12% of total revenue in FY26.
Company repaid ₹525 Cr of borrowings in Q1FY27 post-IPO.
DG set capacity utilisation was 75-80% in Q1FY27 on a single shift.
Data centre order book was ₹900 Cr as of 31 July 2026 and ₹1,100 Cr as of 7 August 2026, with a single order over ₹200 Cr.
Wind IPP portfolio stands at 330.85 MW operating, with 250 MW of new wins taking visibility to 638.35 MW; new projects expected at 82-83% EBITDA margin vs 62-63% for old projects.

GUVNL LoI dated October 19, 2026 covers a 50 MW wind project in Gujarat at ₹3.51/kWh for 25 years, with the PPA due within 15 business days of GERC tariff adoption and commissioning within 24 months of the PPA.

timeline.summary: Q3FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹762.93 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹95.83 Cr.

Powerica Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 29, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST, hosted by Nuvama Wealth Management with **Jai Ram Oberoi**, **Pradeep Gupta**, and **Ritesh Kumar Agrawal** presenting.
2026-05-27: Powerica Limited received a notice of demand for ₹30.28 Cr under Section 143(1) of the Income Tax Act for Assessment Year 2025-26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹801.15 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹42.51 Cr.
2026-05-28: Powerica reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,011.52 Cr (+13.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹277.31 Cr (+61.0%), with wind segment EBITDA margin at 31.3% versus 41.4% in FY25.
Powerica Limited’s earnings call with analysts and investors on May 29, 2026, at 2:00 PM (IST), audio recorded for Q4FY26 results, is available on the company website.
Powerica published the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 29, 2026.
Powerica received a minor GST demand notice of ₹0.01 Cr from Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation on June 5, 2026.

2026-08-14: Powerica filed the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call held on 10 August 2026, where it reported revenue of ₹780 Cr (+26.7% YoY), EBITDA of ₹106 Cr (13.6% margin) and PAT of ₹64 Cr, with a DG set order book of ₹1,700 Cr and data centre order book of ₹1,100 Cr.

2026-10-21: Powerica received a GUVNL Letter of Intent dated October 19, 2026 for a 50 MW wind project in Gujarat at ₹3.51/kWh for 25 years, with the PPA to be signed within 15 business days of GERC tariff adoption and commissioning within 24 months of the PPA.
